mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS recruitmentId, p.id AS postId, b.sport_type_id AS sportTypeId, st.name AS sportName, b.venue_id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, b.start_at AS startAt, b.end_at AS endAt, r.level, r.level_tag AS levelTag, r.max_members AS maxMembers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_post_recruitment_member m WHERE m.recruitment_id = r.id AND m.status = 'APPROVED') AS approvedCount, r.fee_mode AS feeMode, r.aa_amount_fen AS aaAmountFen, r.description, r.status FROM s_post_recruitment r JOIN s_post p ON p.id = r.post_id JOIN s_post_revision rev ON rev.id = p.public_revision_id JOIN s_booking b ON b.id = r.booking_id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = b.sport_type_id JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = b.venue_id WHERE p.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND rev.moderation_status = 'APPROVED' AND p.author_type = 'USER' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_user_account ua WHERE ua.id = p.author_id AND ua.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ua.deleted_at IS NULL) AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rev.booking_id = b.id AND rev.venue_id = b.venue_id AND rev.sport_type_id = b.sport_type_id AND b.user_id = p.author_id AND b.source = 'ONLINE' AND r.status = 'RECRUITING' AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND b.start_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_user_block ub WHERE (ub.blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND ub.blocked_user_id = p.author_id) OR (ub.blocker_user_id = p.author_id AND ub.blocked_user_id = #{userId})) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_post_recruitment_member m2 WHERE m2.recruitment_id = r.id AND m2.status = 'APPROVED') < r.max_members AND b.start_at >= #{dayStart} AND b.start_at < #{nextDayStart} AND b.sport_type_id = #{sportTypeId} AND b.venue_id = #{venueId} AND r.level_tag = #{levelTag} AND (r.max_members - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_post_recruitment_member m3 WHERE m3.recruitment_id = r.id AND m3.status = 'APPROVED')) >= #{minRemaining} ORDER BY b.start_at ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
